findings.title: Routed and unrouted model listed twice
findings.problem: A routed request normalises to the route's undated name (claude-sonnet-4-5 for vertex_ai/claude-sonnet-4-5) while an unrouted request of the same model keeps its dated transcript name (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). The reader's _GRAIN/_TOP_MODEL, the rollup models/primary_model counters and unpriced_models therefore list one model under two names; the storage guide documents the split instead of fixing it and its 'one name in every row' sentence now carries an exception.
findings.impact: top_model and session primary_model rank by calls per name, so a model's calls split across two names and the wrong model can be reported as primary; model lists repeat a model. Reachability (how often one grain mixes routed and unrouted rows of a model, e.g. other clients beside Claude Code) was not confirmed in code.
findings.recommendation: Group and display by the undated normalised name (strip a trailing -YYYYMMDD after normalized_model_name / normalize_model) in _GRAIN/_TOP_MODEL, the rollup models/primary_model counters and unpriced_display_names, so a route and its dated plain name count as one model; update the storage guide rows that document the split.
findings.check_notes: kind code; reader.py unchanged at HEAD 618a20d8. fix_evidence carries only a decision (accepted limitation), which cannot resolve a code finding; re-triage as decision or defer to clear

decision.outcome: accepted by the story owner as a documented limitation; merging the two names is out of scope of EPMCDME-16633 and EPMCDME-16928
decision.rationale: Pricing by the route is done with the backend alone: the name the user chose reaches the backend in no event, and the normaliser is not changed to drop dates because that would move the price tiers (a dated name must not match another date). Showing one name would mean changing how model names are displayed on every screen of the CLI Analytics tab together with the UI's own copy of the normaliser, which neither ticket asks for. The split is stated in .ai-run/guides/integration/cli-analytics-storage.md (the models row and the unpriced_models paragraph) and in the MR description, Deviations. It needs a route whose name is undated while the transcript name is dated, mixed with requests of the same model that carry no route header: among 16 distinct (message.model, x-litellm-model-name) pairs of real Claude Code transcripts one pair is such (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 on vertex_ai/claude-sonnet-4-5).

disposition.rationale: Out of scope of the ticket: merging the two names means changing how model names are displayed on the whole CLI Analytics tab and in the UI's copy of the normaliser.

findings.title: Route keying has no Postgres integration test
findings.problem: EPMCDME-16928 developer AC 2 requires an integration test on a disposable analytics Postgres ingesting a claude-opus-4-6 session and asserting cost_usd equals the catalog calculation, cost_available true, absence from unpriced_models and inclusion in Overview/Cost totals. The diff has none: routed_predicate, _undated, group_model and routed_model_name are only compared as generated SQL text in test_rollups.py (the expected string is built with the same escaping as the builder), and the only live test, test_live_session_subagent_cost.py, does not cover routes. The committed docs/superpowers/reviews/2026-11-10-epmcdme-16633/code-review-final.json and code-review-check.json mark this AC pass citing test_live_catalog_money / test_live_route_cost_key.py, which the merge of main removed.
findings.impact: A required spec criterion is unmet. Consumer: cost_daily rows read by get_session_model_costs / get_session_detail_model_costs and priced through lookup_cost_config's route-map tier. If regex escaping, NULL semantics of min/max FILTER or a dated/undated mismatch evaluate differently in Postgres, routed requests stay keyed by their plain name and price at the plain-name tariff, the exact regression EPMCDME-16928 exists to prevent, and the committed review records would still report it as covered.

findings.title: Vertex uplift and unmapped dated route unpriced
findings.problem: The 2026-11-10 scope comment says MR !4774 removes the Est. Cost divergences of the 2026-11-05 table, including the -vertex aliases. It is partly met: by the MR's own deviation note Vertex requests stay about x1.05 below the charge (x-litellm-model-name carries no location, so the route price is the base one), and a counted route missing from the route map for a dated model whose catalog entries differ in tariff (Opus 4.6 on preview) now goes unpriced and into unpriced_models until a reload, where before it priced by its dated name (test_a_bedrock_v1_route_in_the_route_map_prices_at_its_deployment_and_outside_it_as_its_model_raw asserts lookup_cost_config(route) is None with an empty map).
findings.impact: Est. Cost keeps a known gap against the charged amount for Vertex, and a previously priced dated model can drop to unpriced after deploy until the next catalog reload, contrary to the scope comment the story was amended to.
findings.recommendation: Get a product decision on the 2026-11-10 scope comment: either accept and record in the ticket that Vertex requests stay ~x1.05 below the charge and that a dated model with conflicting tariffs whose route is missing from the map is unpriced until a reload, or carry the regional uplift / fall back to the dated name for routes outside the map; then implement and test the chosen behaviour.
findings.check_notes: id-mapped decision: story owner accepts Vertex ~x1.05 gap (tracked EPMCDME-17065) and unmapped dated route unpriced until reload; non-empty rationale

decision.outcome: accepted by the story owner as known limitations of this MR; the regional Vertex uplift is tracked as the separate bug EPMCDME-17065
decision.rationale: Vertex: LiteLLM adds a regional uplift on non-global Vertex locations and one route (vertex_ai/claude-sonnet-4-6) spans a global and regional deployments; the forwarded x-litellm-model-name carries no location, so pricing it needs the deployment's location carried from the proxy through the plugin into the stored request, which is EPMCDME-17065 and not this MR. A counted route missing from the route map (the catalog not yet reloaded after a LiteLLM deployment change) prices by its plain name; for a dated model whose catalog entries differ in tariff that is unpriced and listed in unpriced_models until the reload: the rule of EPMCDME-16928 that a conflicting-tariff case stays unpriced, no guessing across prices, pinned by test_an_undated_name_with_different_tariffs_stays_unpriced. Both are stated in the MR description, Deviations from the ticket/spec.
